boarding_points.name: Terminal da Balsa Ponta da Praia (Santos)
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Santos head of the Santos–Guarujá balsa, Praça Almirante Gago Coutinho. ~400 m crossing, 24h, ~21,000 vehicles + ~7,600 pedestrians + ~7,700 cyclists/day. Coordinates from OSM node 'Ferryboat - Barca Ponta da Praia (Santos/Guarujá)'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal da Balsa Guarujá (Av. Adhemar de Barros)
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Guarujá head of the Santos–Guarujá balsa, Av. Adhemar de Barros 3300. Coordinates from OSM node 'Barca Ferryboat - (Guarujá/Santos)'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal de Passageiros Santos Centro / Praça da República (linha Vicente de Carvalho & Ilha Diana)
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Santos Centro terminal of the lancha (passenger launch) lines to Vicente de Carvalho and Ilha Diana; new floating pier delivered by Semil in Feb 2024 (R$20M+ terminal works). Coordinates from OSM node 'Terminal de Passageiros Santos-Vicente de Carvalho-Ilha Diana'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal de Passageiros Vicente de Carvalho (Guarujá)
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Guarujá-side head of the Santos–Vicente de Carvalho lancha line (2,200 m, ~12 min, 24h); new floating pier inaugurated Feb 2024. Line is confirmed active and included in the 2025 PPP. Coordinates from OSM node 'Terminal de Passageiros Santos-Vicente de Carvalho'.

boarding_points.name: Catraia pier (Santos–Vicente de Carvalho small-boat crossing)
boarding_points.notes: Named OSM node 'CATRAIA (SANTOS - VICENTE DE CARVALHO)' — the traditional small-boat crossing of the port channel. Exact berth/bank assignment to confirm at survey; the paired catraia node coincides with the Vicente de Carvalho terminal.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap named node; payload prior-scan item verified as mapped

boarding_points.name: Terminal Marítimo de Passageiros Giusfredo Santini (Concais)
boarding_points.notes: Latin America's principal cruise gateway: ~1 million passengers and 152 ship calls forecast for the 2024/25 season. Coordinates from Nominatim/OSM 'Terminal Marítimo de Passageiros - Giusfredo Santini'.

boarding_points.name: Ponte Edgard Perdigão (Terminal Santos–Praia do Góes / N.S. dos Navegantes)
boarding_points.operator: Municipality of Santos / independent launch operators
boarding_points.notes: The Ponta da Praia leisure pier: departure point for small launches to boat-only Praia do Góes and Santa Cruz dos Navegantes, plus schooner tours. Coordinates from OSM pier 'Ponte Edgard Perdigão' / adjacent ferry_terminal node.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap named nodes 'Ponte Edgard Perdigão' and 'Terminal de Passageiros Santos-Praia do Góes e Nossa Senhora dos Navegantes'

boarding_points.name: Praia do Góes landing (Guarujá)
boarding_points.notes: Boat-only beach on the Guarujá side of the harbour mouth, served by launches from Ponte Edgard Perdigão. Coordinates from an unnamed OSM ferry-landing node at the Praia do Góes cove — name unlabelled in OSM, position consistent with the cove; verify signage at survey.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap ferry_terminal node at Praia do Góes cove (unnamed)

boarding_points.name: Marina Dolfin (Santa Cruz dos Navegantes, Guarujá)
boarding_points.notes: Marina at the Santa Cruz dos Navegantes fishing community on the Guarujá point, adjacent to the existing Ponta da Praia small-boat service. Coordinates from OSM marina 'Marina Dolfin'.

boarding_points.name: Porto Marina Astúrias (Guarujá)
boarding_points.notes: Guarujá's flagship full-service marina on the estuary shore near Astúrias beach, with helipad. Coordinates from OSM/Nominatim 'Porto Marina Astúrias'.
boarding_points.source: https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org (Porto Marina Astúrias, Av. Miguel Alfonso Gonzales) | OSM cross-check

boarding_points.name: Iate Clube de Santos — Guarujá nautical base
boarding_points.notes: The Iate Clube de Santos nautical/marina base on the Guarujá bank of the channel (clubhouse is across in Ponta da Praia, Santos). Coordinates from OSM marina 'Iate Clube de Santos'.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap named marina node (Cidade Náutica, Guarujá)

boarding_points.name: Ilha das Palmas (Clube de Pesca de Santos)
boarding_points.operator: Clube de Pesca de Santos / Iate Clube de Santos
boarding_points.notes: Private club island in Santos Bay (Clube de Pesca de Santos, founded 1934; Guarujá territory), boat-access only, members and events. Coordinates from the OSM ferry-landing node at the island; landing name unlabelled in OSM.

boarding_points.name: Terminal de Passageiros Ilha Diana
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo / municipal boat service
boarding_points.notes: Pier of the Ilha Diana fishing-village island in the estuary, served by the public boat from the Santos Centro terminal. Coordinates from OSM pier 'Terminal de Passageiros Ilha Diana-Santos'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal da Balsa Guarujá–Bertioga (Guarujá side)
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Guarujá head of the Guarujá–Bertioga balsa across the Canal de Bertioga; one of the 14 crossings in the 2025 PPP. Coordinates from OSM node 'Balsa Guarujá'.

boarding_points.name: Terminal da Balsa Bertioga
boarding_points.operator: Departamento Hidroviário de São Paulo (DH/Semil); Acqua Vias SP PPP concessionaire from 2026
boarding_points.notes: Bertioga head of the Guarujá–Bertioga balsa — the north-east gateway of the market's water mesh. Coordinates from OSM node 'Balsa Bertioga'.
